name: SteelGuard
description:
About This Game

You're part of SteelGuard, a mechanized combat unit sent to repel invasions by hostile alien races. At the controls of a heavily armed mech, you take the fight straight to the invaders. They bring the hordes. You have an arsenal that would be a shame to leave untested.

Shoot your way out

In Survivors mode, fight waves of enemies, gather experience and choose upgrades during each run. Machine guns clear the front ranks while explosives deal with larger groups. Keep room to move, strengthen your weapons and prepare for bosses that call for a well-timed dodge. Once you have beaten one difficulty, test your build on the next.

There’s always room for more firepower

Each upgrade can strengthen what already works or open the way to a different build. Add damage, shore up your defenses or get the mobility you were missing last time. Between runs, spend your resources on permanent upgrades and change your mech's weapons and gear.

Careful. This one can dodge.

In PvP arenas, another player is at the controls of the opposing mech. Face them in a 1v1v1 arena or join team battles where you can cover each other's backs and corner your opponents together. Use cover, aim carefully and time your abilities to catch an opponent off guard. It pays to know what your weapons can do and where they fall short.
short_desc: Being surrounded has one advantage. It is hard to miss. In SteelGuard, mow down hordes in a combat mech, collect upgrades and see how much firepower you can pack into one build. Survive the assault, defeat bosses and face other pilots in PvP arenas and ranked matches.
